d:
The Pistons defeated the 76ers, 106-93 tonight in Philadelphia. Cade Cunningham finished with a team-high 26 points along with 8 rebounds and 8 assists for the Pistons, while Duncan Robinson tallied 21 points, 5 three pointers and 3 rebounds in the game. Tyrese Maxey recorded 29 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists. The Pistons improve their record to 3-0 with the win, while the 76ers fall to 3-1 for the season.
